welcome.title: Welcome to Gostman
welcome.intro: No account needed. Nothing leaves this device until you send a request.
welcome.hostedRelayNote: In the web version, a request is forwarded through the hosted relay at gostman.com, which stores neither the request nor the answer. The desktop app sends requests directly, and a local relay sends them from your computer. Change it under Preferences, Privacy.
welcome.dismiss: Skip the welcome. Show it again from the command palette with Show welcome.
welcome.commandDescription: Getting started steps, imports and shortcuts
welcome.importHint: From Postman, Bruno, Insomnia, OpenAPI, HAR, .http files or curl.
welcome.folderHint: Keep requests as files next to your code and share them through git.
welcome.collectionHint: Group related requests together in the sidebar.
welcome.curlHint: Paste it into the address bar and the request fills in.
